q: A person invested Rs. 50000 in a fixed deposit. What is the interest earned if the rate of interest is 8% per annum for 3 years?
A man bought 10 shirts at Rs. 50 each. What is the total cost of the shirts?
A woman saved Rs. 2000 per month for 6 months. What is the total amount saved?
A group of friends shared some money among themselves in the ratio 3:5:8. If the total amount shared was Rs. 12000, what was the share of the person who received the smallest amount?
exp: Share of person with smallest amount = (3/16) * 12000 = 3000

q: A person deposited Rs. 500 into a savings account that earns a 6% interest rate. What is the interest earned after 1 year?
A car costs Rs. 80000. If a 10% discount is applied, what is the amount paid by the customer?
A woman bought 5 notebooks at Rs. 20 each. What is the total cost of the notebooks?
A person borrowed Rs. 10000 at a 12% interest rate. What is the interest paid after 2 years?
A group of friends started a business with an initial investment of Rs. 50000. If the profit is shared in the ratio 2:3:5, what is the share of the person who received the largest amount?
exp: Share of person with largest amount = (5/10) * 50000 = 25000
